title: Wholesale prices jumped 6.3% annually in September, biggest gain since 2022
body: September producer prices were expected to increase 0.6% month over month and 5.5% annually, according to the consensus estimate by Dow Jones.

title: U.S. Treasury dismisses IMF debt warning and 'messy' forecasting

title: China indicates rare earths will keep flowing to EU, regardless of U.S. trade deal expiration

title: UK economy grew 0.1% in August, beating expectations
body: The U.K. is grappling with a cost-of-living crisis sparked by sticky inflation and surging energy costs.

title: IMF sees milder global slowdown as AI boom offsets war hit — warns resilience is nearing limits
body: The IMF raised its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1%, warning that resilience is tested by energy constraints and looming fiscal risks.
